8204.title: Git index-copy disposal leaves cleanup promises unobserved
8204.rootCauseOneLine: Index-copy cleanup discards the promise returned by env.then; dispose does not await removal, and an fs.rm rejection escapes the rejection handler attached only to env.

prReviews.topFinding: Returns the cleanup promise, awaits it during disposal, and contains removal failures; linked branch was not executed.

8204.proposedFix: Return a settled cleanup promise, await it during disposal of an idle copy, retry transient filesystem failures, and contain terminal cleanup errors.
8204.caveats: Same-agent reproduction repeated in a second clean checkout on Linux. Native Windows contention was not exercised; EPERM was injected at the real filesystem boundary. Test source and selected output are inline in the report. No duplicate fix PR: open PR 8205 already closes the issue.
